description: A project with its recordings and the settings applied to it. Settings bound to a language are only listed for the languages a share includes.

pronunciations.description: Pronunciation sets applied to the project.

safeCommunications.description: Safe communication checks applied to the project.

preferences.description: Models, profiles and text-to-speech provider of the project. Absent when none were set.

insightsModelType.description: AI model provider type for insights.

translationModelType.description: AI model provider type for translation.

mtProfileId.description: Phrase TMS machine translation profile uid. Get it from the Phrase TMS API (machine translate profiles); Studio has no endpoint that lists it.

translationMemoryId.description: Phrase TMS translation memory uid. Get it from the Phrase TMS API (translation memories); Studio has no endpoint that lists it.

ttsProvider.description: Text-to-speech engine for dubbing, an id from `GET /v1/tts/engines`.

subtitleProfiles.description: Subtitle profile used for each language. Ids from `GET /v1/subtitle-profiles`.

languageCode.description: Language the profile is used for.

styleGuides.description: Style guide ids by language code. Get them from the Style Guides API; Studio has no endpoint that lists them.

items.description: A style guide and its language.

languageCode.description: Language the style guide is used for.

termBases.description: Phrase TMS term base uids by language code. Get them from the Phrase TMS API (term bases); Studio has no endpoint that lists them.

items.description: A term base and its language.

languageCode.description: Language the term base is used for.

tmsProject.description: The translation management project the project is linked to. Absent when there is none.

tmsProjectTemplateUid.description: Phrase TMS project template uid. Get it from the Phrase TMS API (project templates); Studio has no endpoint that lists it.
